                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
The synchronous member function erase of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03103]) serves to remove a single character from a string. It is provided via header #include "ara/core/string.h" [SWS_CORE_03103]. As a parameter, it accepts a const iterator p that points to the character to be deleted and returns a iterator to the subsequent character [SWS_CORE_03103]. The functional behavior follows the corresponding usage of [basic.string] [SWS_CORE_03103].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
In the specification, the property “not exception safe” is designated for the function [SWS_CORE_03103]. Specific error codes, DET, or DEM messages do not exist. In contrast to the index-based overload [SWS_CORE_03102], which provides for a IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation upon index overrun, [SWS_CORE_03103] does not define separate violations. Interpretation: Passing an invalid or non-dereferenceable iterator will likely lead to undefined behavior, as no explicit pre-checks are specified.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Concurrency and Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
Since no synchronization or reentrancy guarantees are specified, concurrent modifying accesses to the same instance without external synchronization will likely not be thread-safe. Within ara::core::BasicString, range deletion using two iterators ([SWS_CORE_03104]) as well as index-based deletion ([SWS_CORE_03102]) are available in addition to this single-element deletion. Similar interfaces for iterator-based deletion are also offered by ara::core::Vector ([SWS_CORE_01372], [SWS_CORE_01373]) and ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01480], [SWS_CORE_01481], [SWS_CORE_01483]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function erase [SWS_CORE_03104]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      iterator erase (const_iterator first, const_iterator last);

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The member function erase of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03104], declared in #include "ara/core/string.h") synchronously removes a sequence of characters in the half-open range between first and last. It follows the corresponding semantics of [basic.string] and returns an iterator to the position after the deleted section.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      For this function, exception safety is explicitly specified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03104]. In contrast to the index-based variant, which provides a IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation on out-of-range access [SWS_CORE_03102], the specification defines no specific error codes or violations for invalid iterator ranges; incorrect iterators are likely to lead to undefined behavior.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Since erase modifies the underlying string and no concurrency mechanisms are specified, the function is likely not reentrant or thread-safe against concurrent accesses to the same instance. In addition, removing elements presumably invalidates subsequent iterators and references in accordance with the standard behavior of [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Within ara::core::BasicString, the function complements the overloads for deleting a single element via iterator [SWS_CORE_03103] as well as the index-based position deletion [SWS_CORE_03102]. In behavior, it corresponds to the range-based erase operations of other AUTOSAR containers such as ara::core::Vector [SWS_CORE_01373] or ara::core::Map [SWS_CORE_01483].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          function find [SWS_CORE_03315]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          size_type find (StringView sv, size_type pos=0) const noexcept;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03315]) searches a string synchronously starting from the specified position pos (default value 0) for the first occurrence of the passed substring StringView sv. The result is returned as size_type. The semantics correspond to the usage in [basic.string], with the deviation that charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03315]). The function is provided via the header ara/core/string.h.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The function is declared as noexcept and classified as exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03315]). It does not throw exceptions. Specific AUTOSAR error codes or messages to DET or DEM are not specified for this function.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Since find is declared as const and does not modify the state of the calling object ([SWS_CORE_03315]), concurrent read accesses by multiple threads to the same instance should be safe without synchronization as long as no write operations take place (interpretation).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Within ara::core::BasicString, this method complements related overloads such as the search for a BasicString instance ([SWS_CORE_03407]), which is also noexcept. Unlike the overloads for single characters ([SWS_CORE_03324]) or pointers ([SWS_CORE_03408], [SWS_CORE_03409]), which are declared as not exception safe, the StringView variant guarantees exception safety. In addition, ara::core::StringView provides an analogous find ([SWS_CORE_02157]), which is however declared as constexpr.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              function find [SWS_CORE_03324]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              size_type find (value_type c, size_type pos=0) const;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The synchronous member function find of class ara::core::BasicString searches from the optional start position pos for the first occurrence of the character c of type value_type ([SWS_CORE_03324]). The semantics correspond to the specification in [basic.string], with charT being replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03324]). If the search is successful, the index is returned as size_type; otherwise, according to the standard behavior of [basic.string], the return value is likely to correspond to the value BasicString::npos.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Regarding exception safety, the function is explicitly classified in the specification as not exception safe (not exception safe) ([SWS_CORE_03324]). Specific error or diagnostic messages via DET or DEM are not defined in the payload. Since the function is declared as const, it does not modify the object; concurrent read accesses to the same instance are therefore likely to be safe regarding concurrency, whereas concurrent write accesses require external synchronization.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In the union of Core types, this method complements related overloads of ara::core::BasicString: While pointer searches with const value_type* are likewise considered not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03408], [SWS_CORE_03409]), overloads for BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03407]) and StringView ([SWS_CORE_03315]) are specified as exception safe and noexcept. For non-owning strings, ara::core::StringView offers with find(char, size_type) an analogous search function that is, however, capable of constexpr and noexcept ([SWS_CORE_02158]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function find of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03407], header ara/core/string.h) synchronously searches for the first occurrence of the passed substring str. The search starts optionally at position pos (default value 0) and follows the specifications from [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The function returns the found index as a value of type size_type. Interpretation: If no match is found, the function is likely to return the value BasicString::npos according to the semantics of [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding error handling and concurrency, the method is declared as noexcept and specified as exception safe (exception safe) ([SWS_CORE_03407]). Since it is a constant operation (const), the call does not modify the object; concurrent read accesses to the same instance are therefore likely to be safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Within ara::core::BasicString, further search functions exist: In addition to the overload for StringView ([SWS_CORE_03315]), which is also declared as noexcept, variants for individual characters ([SWS_CORE_03324]) and character pointers ([SWS_CORE_03408], [SWS_CORE_03409]) are available, which, in contrast, are classified as not exception safe. Corresponding search operations are furthermore found in ara::core::StringView ([SWS_CORE_02157]) and ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01490]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The method find of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03408]) searches a string synchronously starting from the index position pos for the first occurrence of the passed character sequence s. The behavior corresponds to the specification in [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03408]). As a constant member function, the call does not modify the calling object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Parameters: s is a pointer to the array to be searched, consisting of elements of type value_type; pos determines the start index for the search with default value 0 ([SWS_CORE_03408]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Return value: The found position is returned as size_type ([SWS_CORE_03408]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Exception safety: The function is explicitly declared as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03408]). It thus deviates from overloads for StringView ([SWS_CORE_03315]) and const BasicString& ([SWS_CORE_03407]), which are defined as noexcept.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Concurrency and validity: Concurrent read accesses are likely to be possible without synchronization, whereas simultaneous write operations require coordination (Interpretation: standard container behavior). The pointer s presumably must point to a valid, null-terminated sequence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      In the union of search functions of ara::core::BasicString, there exists, in addition to this variant, also an overload with explicit length limitation n ([SWS_CORE_03409]) as well as a search for individual characters ([SWS_CORE_03324]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find of class ara::core::BasicString serves the synchronous search for a character sequence within the string according to [SWS_CORE_03409]. It searches the instance starting from the specified position pos for the first n characters of the passed pointer s of type const value_type* and, in case of a match, returns the zero-based index as size_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Usage and Parameters
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The call is made via header ara/core/string.h [SWS_CORE_03409]. The behavior follows the semantics of [basic.string] of the C++ standard, with charT replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03409]. The function operates synchronously as a const method and does not modify the existing object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The specification explicitly classifies the function as "not exception safe" [SWS_CORE_03409]. Presumably, no defined exception handling is guaranteed in case of invalid memory areas or a null pointer for s. Specific AUTOSAR error codes as well as DET or DEM reports are not defined in the payload. Because this is a reading member function, simultaneous access by multiple threads should be reentrant as long as no concurrent write operations take place on the same instance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          In addition to this overload, ara::core::BasicString offers alternative search methods such as the null-termination variant find(const value_type* s, size_type pos=0) [SWS_CORE_03408], the single search find(value_type c, size_type pos=0) [SWS_CORE_03324], and the overloads defined as exception safe for BasicString [SWS_CORE_03407] and StringView [SWS_CORE_03315]. For read-only character sequences, the exception safe variant in ara::core::StringView is available analogously [SWS_CORE_02159].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              size_type find_first_of (const BasicString &str, size_type pos=0) const noexcept;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The method find_first_of of class ara::core::BasicString is provided via header ara/core/string.h and serves to synchronously search for characters within a string [SWS_CORE_03329]. It determines the first occurrence of any character from the passed string str starting at start position pos, which defaults to 0 [SWS_CORE_03329]. The behavior conforms to the semantics of [basic.string] [SWS_CORE_03329]. Interpretation: If there is no match, the return value according to standard behavior is likely to correspond to the value npos.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Regarding error handling and exception safety, the operation is declared as noexcept and classified as exception safe [SWS_CORE_03329]. Consequently, it throws no exceptions. Specific development or production errors such as DET or DEM messages are not defined in the payload. Since this is a read-only const method, the call does not lead to state changes of the instance [SWS_CORE_03329].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In interplay within ara::core::BasicString, this signature complements further overloads of find_first_of: while the reference variant for BasicString is exception-safe [SWS_CORE_03329], overloads for pointer const value_type *s with length specification [SWS_CORE_03330] or null termination [SWS_CORE_03331] as well as for single characters value_type c [SWS_CORE_03332] are designated as not exception safe. For the inverted search for the first character that does not occur in the comparison set, the method find_first_not_of is analogously available, which likewise includes an exception-safe BasicString overload [SWS_CORE_03337] as well as pointer and character variants [SWS_CORE_03338], [SWS_CORE_03339], [SWS_CORE_03340].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  function find_first_ [SWS_CORE_03330]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  size_type find_first_of (const value_type *s, size_type pos, size_type n) const;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The method find_first_of according to [SWS_CORE_03330] serves for synchronously searching for the first occurrence of any character from a character sequence within an instance of ara::core::BasicString. It is provided via the header ara/core/string.h and follows the behavior of the C++ standard library for [basic.string], with the parameter type charT being replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03330].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Parameters and Return Value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • s: Pointer to the character sequence (type const value_type*) whose elements are searched for. Interpretation: The pointer s is likely to point to a valid array with at least n elements [SWS_CORE_03330].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • pos: Starting position within the string from which the search begins.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • n: Number of characters to consider starting from the address s.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Return value: Returns the index of the first match of type size_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Exception Safety and Related Interfaces
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  In contrast to the overload for complete BasicString objects according to [SWS_CORE_03329], which is declared as noexcept and exception safe, this function is explicitly classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03330]. This applies equally to the overloads without length specification n according to [SWS_CORE_03331] and for single characters according to [SWS_CORE_03332].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  For the inverse search for characters that do not occur in the target sequence, the analogous find_first_not_of methods are available, in particular the pointer overload with length limitation according to [SWS_CORE_03338] as well as the variants [SWS_CORE_03337], [SWS_CORE_03339], and [SWS_CORE_03340].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The method find_first_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03331]) serves for the synchronous search for the first occurrence of any character from the passed character sequence s. The semantics correspond to the definition in [basic.string], with charT being replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03331]). By default, the search starts at index pos = 0.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The function is specified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03331]). Specific error codes such as DET or DEM messages are not defined in the specification. Presumably, exceptions might be possible in the event of faulty parameters or internal processes, whereas the string overload [SWS_CORE_03329] is declared as exception safe and noexcept.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      As a const member function, the call does not modify the calling instance ([SWS_CORE_03331]). Since no explicit length parameter is passed, the pointer s is likely required to point to a valid, null-terminated character sequence to prevent undefined reading of memory regions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The method is part of the search interfaces of ara::core::BasicString from header #include "ara/core/string.h" ([SWS_CORE_03331]):
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Overload with additional length limitation n: [SWS_CORE_03330].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Overload for a single character: [SWS_CORE_03332].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Exception-safe overload with BasicString: [SWS_CORE_03329].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Inverse search for non-occurring characters (find_first_not_of): [SWS_CORE_03337], [SWS_CORE_03338], [SWS_CORE_03339], and [SWS_CORE_03340].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find_first_of according to [SWS_CORE_03332] serves to find the first occurrence of a single character within an instance of ara::core::BasicString. The semantics correspond to the standard usage in [basic.string], with the only deviation being that charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03332]). The declaration is available via header #include "ara/core/string.h" in namespace ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03332]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The method accepts the sought character c of type value_type and optionally the start position pos of type size_type (default value 0) and returns an index of type size_type ([SWS_CORE_03332]). Regarding exception handling, this overload is explicitly classified as not exception safe (not exception safe, [SWS_CORE_03332]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          In interplay within the search functions of ara::core::BasicString, this method complements other variants for character and substring searching:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The overload for searching for a BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03329]), which in contrast is declared as noexcept and exception-safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The overloads for searching using pointers to strings const value_type* with subrange specification ([SWS_CORE_03330]) or default start position ([SWS_CORE_03331]), both of which are also specified as not exception safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The complementary function group find_first_not_of, in particular for negated single-character search according to [SWS_CORE_03340] as well as the variants for strings ([SWS_CORE_03337], [SWS_CORE_03338], [SWS_CORE_03339]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            •
