                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The member function find_first_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03337], header file #include "ara/core/string.h") serves for pattern searching in strings. As parameters, the synchronous method expects a comparison string const BasicString &str and optionally a start index size_type pos = 0. According to the specification, the semantics correspond to usage in [basic.string]; as return value of type size_type, the function is likely to yield the index of the first character starting at position pos that does not occur in str, or npos if the search is unsuccessful.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error handling
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The operation is declared with the identifier noexcept and classified in [SWS_CORE_03337] as exception-safe ("exception safe"). Specific error codes or notifications to DET or DEM are not defined for this function.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              As a const method (const), the function makes no state-changing interventions on the calling instance. Specific synchronization mechanisms or reentrancy rules do not emerge from [SWS_CORE_03337].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The signature is related to other search operations of ara::core::BasicString:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It acts as a complement to the function find_first_of with BasicString reference ([SWS_CORE_03329]), which is likewise specified as noexcept and exception-safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • In contrast to [SWS_CORE_03337], the overloads for raw pointers ([SWS_CORE_03338], [SWS_CORE_03339]) and single characters ([SWS_CORE_03340]) as well as their counterparts in find_first_of ([SWS_CORE_03330], [SWS_CORE_03331], [SWS_CORE_03332]) are explicitly designated as not exception safe ("not exception safe") and replace charT with value_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function find_first_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03338]) synchronously searches a string from the specified position pos for the first character that is not contained in the passed character array s of length n. The declaration is provided via the header file #include "ara/core/string.h". The semantics are based on the standard function [basic.string] of the C++ standard library, with the parameter type charT being replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03338]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding execution context and error behavior, the following properties are specified:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Return value: Returns the index of the first non-matching character as size_type ([SWS_CORE_03338]); if no differing character is found or if pos is outside the valid range, the value npos is likely returned analogously to the standard behavior of [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Exception safety: According to the specification, the function is explicitly classified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03338]). Unlike the overload for BasicString, it has no noexcept guarantee ([SWS_CORE_03337]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Pointer validity: The pointer s must point to an array with at least n valid elements; a null pointer or insufficient buffer size is likely to lead to undefined behavior.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  In interaction within ara::core::BasicString, this overload complements the search with standard null-termination ([SWS_CORE_03339]), the search for single characters ([SWS_CORE_03340]), and the corresponding positive search functions find_first_of ([SWS_CORE_03329], [SWS_CORE_03330], [SWS_CORE_03331], [SWS_CORE_03332]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Usage: The method find_first_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03339]) from header #include "ara/core/string.h" searches synchronously from position pos (default value 0) for the first character that does not occur in the null-terminated string s of type const value_type*. The behavior corresponds to the C++ standard reference [basic.string], with charT being replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03339]). The found index position is returned as size_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error handling and constraints: The element is explicitly specified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03339]). Specific error codes, return values for error states, or AUTOSAR diagnostic messages (DET/DEM) are not defined for this function. The caller is responsible for the validity of the pointer s; interpretation: an invalid or non-null-terminated pointer presumably leads to undefined behavior according to the underlying [basic.string] semantics. As a const member function, the method is reentrant for concurrent read accesses to the same instance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interaction: The function is part of the search interfaces of ara::core::BasicString. While the overload for complete instances BasicString is defined as noexcept and exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03337]), pointer-based variants such as the search with length limitation n ([SWS_CORE_03338]) and single-character searches ([SWS_CORE_03340]) are likewise classified as not exception safe. The positive counterpart for searching for matching characters is formed by the corresponding find_first_of overloads ([SWS_CORE_03329], [SWS_CORE_03330], [SWS_CORE_03331], [SWS_CORE_03332]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Usage and Semantics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find_first_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03340]) from header ara/core/string.h synchronously searches from start index pos (default value 0) for the first character that does not match the passed character c of type value_type. The behavior is governed by C++ standard section [basic.string], with charT being replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03340]). If the search finds no differing character, the return value is likely to be npos according to standard convention.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The specification declares the function as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03340]). Neither specific AUTOSAR error codes nor DET or DEM messages are defined in the payload. Callers must take into account that, in contrast to the string overload ([SWS_CORE_03337]), which is defined as noexcept and exception safe, freedom from exceptions is not guaranteed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Concurrency and Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Since it is a const method (const), the call does not modify the string; concurrent read accesses across multiple threads are likely permissible without synchronization as long as no write operations take place. The function complements the overloads for searching differing subsequences via pointer ([SWS_CORE_03338], [SWS_CORE_03339]) or BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03337]) and forms the counterpart to the find_first_of methods ([SWS_CORE_03329], [SWS_CORE_03330], [SWS_CORE_03331], [SWS_CORE_03332]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Usage and Semantics
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The member function find_first_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03319]) synchronously searches a string starting from the specified index position pos. It determines the first character that does not occur in the passed ara::core::StringView sv. The semantics are based on the behavior of [basic.string] ([SWS_CORE_03319]). Upon a successful search, the zero-based index of the match is returned, otherwise the value for invalid positions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The function is declared with noexcept and specified as exception-safe (exception safe) ([SWS_CORE_03319]). It throws no exceptions and generates no AUTOSAR error messages such as DET or DEM. If a start index is passed that lies past the end of the string, the operation regularly results in no match.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              As a non-modifying const method, concurrent read access to the same instance is likely thread-safe as long as no write accesses to the string take place. Within ara::core::BasicString, it complements related search operations such as the overload for BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03337]) as well as variants for pointers and single characters ([SWS_CORE_03338], [SWS_CORE_03339], [SWS_CORE_03340]). A corresponding interface on pure view objects is provided by ara::core::StringView via [SWS_CORE_02173].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function find_first_of according to [SWS_CORE_03317] of class ara::core::BasicString (defined in header #include "ara/core/string.h") synchronously searches a string for the first occurrence of any character from the passed StringView sv. The search starts by default from index position pos = 0. The behavior corresponds to the definition in [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type. As return value, the function returns the found position of type size_type; if no matching character is found, the return value is presumably npos (interpretation: derived from the referenced standard behavior of [basic.string]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The method is declared as noexcept and considered exception-safe (exception safe) according to [SWS_CORE_03317]. It throws no exceptions; specific error codes or reports to diagnostic and monitoring services (such as DET or DEM) are not provided. Since it is a reading const operation without modification of the object state, parallel calls on the same instance without synchronization should be reentrant and thread-safe (interpretation: typical semantics for side-effect-free methods).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Within ara::core::BasicString, this method complements the overload for const BasicString& [SWS_CORE_03329] and enables passing string views without additional memory allocations. In contrast to the pointer and character overloads [SWS_CORE_03330], [SWS_CORE_03331], and [SWS_CORE_03332], which are listed as not exception-safe, this signature provides guaranteed exception safety. Similar search operations are also available directly on ara::core::StringView, for example via [SWS_CORE_02165].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The method find_last_of of class ara::core::BasicString serves to find the last occurrence of a character from the passed string str up to position pos [SWS_CORE_03333]. The declaration takes place in header ara/core/string.h and behaves according to the corresponding usage in [basic.string] [SWS_CORE_03333]. Interpretation: The reference [basic.string] presumably refers to the chapter of the same name in the C++ standard on std::basic_string.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Usage and semantics: The call is synchronous and performed as a const member function (const) on an instance of ara::core::BasicString [SWS_CORE_03333]. Parameters are the search string str of type const BasicString& and the optional start position pos of type size_type with the default value npos [SWS_CORE_03333]. The return value is of type size_type and yields the index of the found character or npos if no matching character exists [SWS_CORE_03333].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error handling and exception safety: This overload is explicitly declared as noexcept and classified as exception safe [SWS_CORE_03333]; it thus does not throw any exceptions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interplay with related functions: In addition to this variant with BasicString, overloads exist for find_last_of for pointer const value_type* [SWS_CORE_03344], [SWS_CORE_03335] as well as for single characters value_type [SWS_CORE_03336], which unlike this function are not classified as exception-safe (not exception safe). The complementary counterpart to searching for characters not contained in the comparison string is represented by the function family find_last_not_of, whose BasicString variant is likewise noexcept and exception-safe [SWS_CORE_03341], while its pointer and character overloads are declared as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03342], [SWS_CORE_03343], [SWS_CORE_03344].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find_last_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03334]) serves to synchronously search for the last occurrence of a character from a subsequence of a C string. It is defined in header #include "ara/core/string.h" ([SWS_CORE_03334]). The function accepts a pointer s to a character array of type const value_type*, a start position pos for beginning the backward search, and the number n of characters to consider from s ([SWS_CORE_03334]). The behavior corresponds to standard [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03334]). The index of the last match is returned as size_type as return value ([SWS_CORE_03334]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Boundary Conditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The operation is specified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03334]). Specific error codes, DET, or DEM messages are not provided in the payload. As a const member function, it does not modify the calling instance ([SWS_CORE_03334]). Interpretation: Since the function processes a raw pointer s together with a length specification n, the caller should be responsible for ensuring that the referenced memory range comprises at least n valid characters.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The function is directly related to other search methods of ara::core::BasicString:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In contrast to this function, the overload with const BasicString& ([SWS_CORE_03333]) provides exception safety (exception safe) and is declared as noexcept.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The overload for character arrays with default value pos = npos ([SWS_CORE_03335]) and the overload for single characters value_type ([SWS_CORE_03336]) are classified as not exception safe, just like this function.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For finding characters that are not contained in the set, an analogous three-parameter signature exists with find_last_not_of ([SWS_CORE_03342]) along with associated variants ([SWS_CORE_03341], [SWS_CORE_03343], [SWS_CORE_03344]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The member function find_last_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03335]) is included via the header file #include "ara/core/string.h". It searches the string synchronously and backward starting from position pos (by default npos) for the last occurrence of any character from the passed sequence s. The behavior corresponds to the definition in [basic.string], with the deviation that charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03335]). Upon a successful search, the index is returned as size_type, otherwise npos.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Exception Behavior and Fault Tolerance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In contrast to the string reference overload ([SWS_CORE_03333]), which is declared as exception safe with noexcept, the classification not exception safe applies to this function ([SWS_CORE_03335]). Interpretation: The pointer s should point to a null-terminated character array; an invalid pointer or memory range can therefore presumably not be intercepted.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interplay and Related Functions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The specification defines several related overloads within ara::core::BasicString:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For targeted partial lengths, there exists the overload with length parameter n ([SWS_CORE_03334]), as well as for single characters c ([SWS_CORE_03336]), both of which are likewise declared as not exception safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The function find_last_of with const BasicString& ([SWS_CORE_03333]) offers full exception safety.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For complementary search for characters that are not contained in the search set, the find_last_not_of variants ([SWS_CORE_03341], [SWS_CORE_03342], [SWS_CORE_03343], [SWS_CORE_03344]) are available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The synchronous member function find_last_of of class ara::core::BasicString from header file #include "ara/core/string.h" searches for the last occurrence of a single character c of type value_type at or before index position pos [SWS_CORE_03336]. The semantics correspond to the specification in [basic.string] with the documented deviation that charT is replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03336]. The index of the character is found as size_type; otherwise npos is returned [SWS_CORE_03336].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding error handling, the method is specified as not exception safe (\"not exception safe\") [SWS_CORE_03336]. Specific error codes and messages to DET or DEM are not stated in the sources. In the event of an error, internal exceptions should be propagated to the caller, since the signature, unlike the string overload [SWS_CORE_03333], does not provide noexcept.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Since this is a const member function (const), the state of the object is not modified [SWS_CORE_03336]. Concurrent read accesses to the same instance should be permissible without additional synchronization, whereas concurrent write operations must be synchronized.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The method fits into the search operations of ara::core::BasicString. It complements the overloads for searching for BasicString objects [SWS_CORE_03333] as well as pointer arrays const value_type* with and without length restriction [SWS_CORE_03334], [SWS_CORE_03335]. The complementary counterpart for characters that do not match is formed by find_last_not_of for single characters [SWS_CORE_03344] as well as for strings and pointers [SWS_CORE_03341], [SWS_CORE_03342], [SWS_CORE_03343].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The member function find_last_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03341]) from header ara/core/string.h serves to find the last character that does not match the characters of the passed string. According to the specification, the functional behavior is oriented toward the corresponding usage in [basic.string] [SWS_CORE_03341]. The method is executed synchronously and accepts as parameters a reference str of type const BasicString& as well as an optional start position pos of type size_type, whose default value is npos [SWS_CORE_03341]. The return value is of type size_type and denotes the index of the found character [SWS_CORE_03341].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regarding error handling, no DET or DEM messages and no specific error codes are defined. The method is declared as noexcept and has the property exception safe [SWS_CORE_03341]. Interpretation: If no differing character can be determined, the function should return the value npos, analogous to the C++ standard [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Since this is a const member function (const), concurrent read access to the same string instance should be harmless as long as no write operations take place. In interplay with related string operations, the function forms the counterpart to find_last_of [SWS_CORE_03333]. While the overload for const BasicString& is exception safe [SWS_CORE_03341], overloads of find_last_not_of for pointers to const value_type* ([SWS_CORE_03342], [SWS_CORE_03343]) as well as for single characters value_type [SWS_CORE_03344] are explicitly classified as not exception safe (not exception safe).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find_last_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03342]) is provided via header ara/core/string.h. It searches the string backward starting at position pos for the last character that is not contained in the array of value_type specified by pointer s and count n. The functional semantics conform to the requirements for [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03342]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          In the specification, this overload is explicitly classified as not exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03342]). Interpretation: Consequently, there is no noexcept guarantee, which is why callers must not assume freedom from exceptions in the event of invalid pointer parameters or out-of-range conditions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interplay with related methods
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The method fits into the family of search functions of ara::core::BasicString:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • While the overload for const BasicString& ([SWS_CORE_03341]) is defined as noexcept and exception-safe, [SWS_CORE_03342] requires explicitly passing pointer and length.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The variant without length parameter n ([SWS_CORE_03343]) as well as the single-character search for value_type ([SWS_CORE_03344]) share the property not exception safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The direct counterpart to searching for contained characters is the find_last_of group ([SWS_CORE_03333], [SWS_CORE_03334], [SWS_CORE_03335], [SWS_CORE_03336]), whose signature with length restriction ([SWS_CORE_03334]) is structured identically.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              function find_last_ [SWS_CORE_03343]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              size_type find_last_not_of (const value_type *s, size_type pos=npos) const;
