                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The member function find_last_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03343]) is used for searching backwards for the last character within the string that does not match any of the characters contained in the null-terminated character array s. pos acts as an optional start index, which defaults to npos. The semantics follow the specification of [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03343]). Inclusion of header ara/core/string.h is required ([SWS_CORE_03343]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In contrast to the string overload [SWS_CORE_03341], which is specified as noexcept (\"exception safe\"), this pointer overload is explicitly classified as \"not exception safe\" ([SWS_CORE_03343]). Specific DET or DEM error messages are not defined for this function. Since the reference to [basic.string] does not prescribe any special AUTOSAR error checks, providing a valid, null-terminated pointer s is likely the sole responsibility of the caller.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interplay and overloads
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Within ara::core::BasicString, the function belongs to a group of related search operations:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • For searching for non-matching characters, in addition to this signature, the overload for const BasicString &str ([SWS_CORE_03341]), the count limitation via pos, n ([SWS_CORE_03342]), and the single-character search ([SWS_CORE_03344]) are available.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Complementary to this, the method family find_last_of serves to find the last matching character ([SWS_CORE_03333], [SWS_CORE_03334], [SWS_CORE_03335], [SWS_CORE_03336]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                •

     

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  function find_last_ [SWS_CORE_03344]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  size_type find_last_not_of (value_type c, size_type pos=npos) const;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  As per corresponding usage in                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   The member function find_last_not_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03344], declared in #include "ara/core/string.h") searches a string synchronously and backwards for the last element that does not correspond to the passed character c. The start index of the search is controlled via the parameter pos, which defaults to npos. Execution follows specification [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03344]. Interpretation: If no non-matching character can be determined, the function will likely return npos.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Regarding error handling, the function is expressly classified in the specification as not exception safe (not exception safe) [SWS_CORE_03344]. Specific error codes or mechanisms such as DET or DEM notifications are not defined in the payload.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Since the method is declared as const, it does not modify the object [SWS_CORE_03344]. Concurrent read accesses to the same string instance are possible synchronously without state changes, as long as no concurrent write operations take place.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Within ara::core::BasicString, the function is part of a group of further search operations:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The counterpart find_last_of ([SWS_CORE_03336]) is used to search for the last occurrence of a matching character.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • For strings and character buffers, corresponding overloads with pointers are available ([SWS_CORE_03342], [SWS_CORE_03343] and [SWS_CORE_03334], [SWS_CORE_03335]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • In contrast to the overload for full instances of BasicString [SWS_CORE_03341] (analogous to [SWS_CORE_03333]), which is declared as noexcept and exception-safe, this single-character variant has no noexcept guarantee.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function find_last_not_of [SWS_CORE_03320]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      size_type find_last_not_of (StringView sv, size_type pos=npos) const noexcept;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The method [SWS_CORE_03320] of class ara::core::BasicString is available via the header <ara/core/string.h>. It performs a synchronous backward search and determines the index of the last character of the string that does not occur in the passed view sv. The search range begins at pos, whose default value is npos. The behavior follows the semantics of [basic.string]; if no differing character is found, the function presumably returns the value npos.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      With regard to error handling, the function is specified as noexcept and classified as exception safe [SWS_CORE_03320]. It thus throws no exceptions. Specific AUTOSAR error codes or reports to error channels (DET/DEM) do not exist for this operation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      As a non-modifying const method, the invocation does not alter the state of the string. Concurrent read accesses by multiple threads to the same instance are therefore likely safe without external synchronization, whereas concurrent modifications must be protected.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The function accepts parameters of type ara::core::StringView, which enables efficient comparisons without memory allocations. Within ara::core::BasicString, it complements overloads for strings [SWS_CORE_03341], raw pointers [SWS_CORE_03342], [SWS_CORE_03343], and single characters [SWS_CORE_03344]. In contrast to the pointer and character variants, the StringView overload is exception-safe. Corresponding search functions exist analogously on ara::core::StringView itself [SWS_CORE_02177], [SWS_CORE_02178], [SWS_CORE_02179], [SWS_CORE_02180].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          function find_last_of [SWS_CORE_03318]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          size_type find_last_of (StringView sv, size_type pos=npos) const noexcept;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function find_last_of of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03318]) searches a string backward for the last occurrence of a character contained in the passed StringView sv. The search takes place synchronously and starts at or before the specified position pos, which is defaulted to npos. According to the reference to [basic.string], the function should return the zero-based index of the found character or npos if no matching character exists.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Regarding error handling, the operation is declared with noexcept and classified as exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03318]). Callers can thus rely on no exceptions being thrown during the search. Specific error codes or error messages via DET or DEM are not provided for this fundamental helper function.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Since it is a const member function (const) that does not modify the state of the object, concurrent read accesses on the same instance should be uncritical as long as no conflicting write accesses take place.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          In the family of string classes, this overload shares its exception safety with the variant for const BasicString& ([SWS_CORE_03333]). In contrast, overloads based on raw pointers and single characters ([SWS_CORE_03334], [SWS_CORE_03335], [SWS_CORE_03336]) are specified as not exception safe. Comparable search functions are also provided in ara::core::StringView ([SWS_CORE_02169], [SWS_CORE_02170], [SWS_CORE_02171], [SWS_CORE_02172]), which are additionally marked with constexpr.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          BasicString & insert (size_type pos, const BasicString &str);

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function insert of ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03093]) serves to synchronously insert a string at a specified position. It expects the index pos of type size_type as well as a const reference str to the BasicString object to be inserted and returns a reference to the modified instance ([SWS_CORE_03093]). The functional behavior follows the corresponding semantics in [basic.string] ([SWS_CORE_03093]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Specific error codes and reports to DET or DEM are not defined for this function. It is explicitly classified in the specification as “not exception safe” ([SWS_CORE_03093]). If an error occurs during the insertion process or a necessary memory allocation, no exception safety guarantees are likely to exist for the object state (interpretation).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The invocation occurs synchronously in the context of the caller. With concurrent read and write access of multiple threads to the same string instance, thread safety is likely not given without external synchronization (interpretation).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          This behavior fits consistently into the specification pattern of AUTOSAR Adaptive containers: In related containers such as ara::core::Vector ([SWS_CORE_01367]) or ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01460]) as well, the insert overloads follow the corresponding C++ standard containers and are consistently marked as not exception safe.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Usage and Call Context
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    The member function insert of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03094]) inserts substrings of a source string into the current string. It is provided via the header ara/core/string.h ([SWS_CORE_03094]). As arguments, the function accepts the insertion index pos1, the source reference str, the start index pos2 within str, and optionally the number of characters to insert n with the default value npos ([SWS_CORE_03094]). The return value is a reference to the modified BasicString object ([SWS_CORE_03094]).
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    The behavior generally follows the standard library [basic.string], but exhibits a specific deviation: If pos1 > size() or pos2 > str.size() applies, a IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is thrown instead of std::out_of_range ([SWS_CORE_03094]). The operation is specified as not exception-safe (not exception safe) ([SWS_CORE_03094]). If an error occurs, it is therefore not ensured that the object remains in a valid initial state.
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    Interpretation: Since the method call directly modifies the target instance and no synchronization properties are mentioned, the function is likely neither reentrant nor thread-safe upon concurrent access to the same instance. Callers must synchronize concurrent accesses externally.
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interplay with related containers
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
    Corresponding insert functions also exist for other AUTOSAR containers such as ara::core::Vector ([SWS_CORE_01367], [SWS_CORE_01369]) and ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01460], [SWS_CORE_01468]). While those overloads primarily use position-based iterators or nodes, the present string operation works index-based; common to all implementations is the exclusion of exception safety ([SWS_CORE_03094], [SWS_CORE_01367], [SWS_CORE_01460]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  function insert [SWS_CORE_03095]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  BasicString & insert (size_type pos, const value_type *s, size_type n);

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function insert of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03095], provided via the header ara/core/string.h) synchronously inserts a character sequence of n characters of pointer s (type const value_type*) starting at the zero-based index position pos into the existing string. The behavior follows the semantics of [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type. As a return value, the function returns a reference to the calling BasicString object, which enables call chaining [SWS_CORE_03095].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Boundary Conditions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Instead of standard C++ exceptions, the implementation triggers AUTOSAR-specific violations [SWS_CORE_03095]:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If the insertion position is past the end of the string (condition pos > size(); designated as pos1 > size() in the specification text), a IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is triggered instead of std::out_of_range [SWS_CORE_03095].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If the total size after insertion exceeds the permissible maximum (size() + n > max_size()), a IsoStdLengthErrorViolation is triggered instead of std::length_error [SWS_CORE_03095].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Concurrency and Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The operation is specified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03095]. Interpretation: Parallel modifying accesses to the same BasicString instance are likely not thread-safe and therefore require external synchronization protection. In contrast to related container operations such as ara::core::Vector::insert [SWS_CORE_01367] or ara::core::Map::insert [SWS_CORE_01460], which operate iterator-based and return iterators, positioning here is performed index-based via indices.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The member function insert of class ara::core::BasicString inserts a null-terminated character array into the existing string object starting at position pos ([SWS_CORE_03096]). Declaration takes place via the header file ara/core/string.h ([SWS_CORE_03096]). The functional behavior corresponds to standard usage according to [basic.string], with the specific deviation that the character type charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03096]). Execution takes place synchronously and returns a reference to the modified instance ([SWS_CORE_03096]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Error Handling and Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The interface is explicitly specified as not exception-safe (not exception safe) ([SWS_CORE_03096]). Specific error codes, return values for error reporting, or messages to DET or DEM are not defined for this function. The passed pointer s presumably must point to a valid, null-terminated array, as invalid memory accesses or errors during reallocation are not intercepted. Modifying calls on the same instance are presumably not thread-safe during parallel accesses and require external synchronization.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The operation fits into the unified interface design of ara::core. Analogous insert overloads exist for ara::core::Vector ([SWS_CORE_01367], [SWS_CORE_01368], [SWS_CORE_01370]) as well as for ara::core::Map ([SWS_CORE_01460], [SWS_CORE_01468] with insert_return_type according to [SWS_CORE_01418]), which are also consistently declared as not exception safe.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Usage and signature
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
The member function insert of class ara::core::BasicString is provided via header #include "ara/core/string.h" [SWS_CORE_03097]. It serves to synchronously insert n consecutive characters c of type value_type at character position pos:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
BasicString & insert (size_type pos, size_type n, value_type c);

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
The function returns a reference to the calling BasicString object, thus enabling method chaining. The semantics correspond to the specification for [basic.string], with the only deviation that the type parameter charT is replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03097].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
Regarding exception safety, the function is explicitly classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03097]. Specific error codes, AUTOSAR return values, or messages to DET/DEM are not defined. Interpretation: If an internal memory allocation fails or if pos lies outside the valid range of the string, the instance is likely to remain in an inconsistent state, as no recovery guarantees are specified.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
Regarding concurrency, the specification contains no synchronization mechanisms. Interpretation: Modifying calls of insert on the same instance of ara::core::BasicString are unlikely to be thread-safe and require external protection upon concurrent access.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interaction in module core
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
The function joins the interfaces of the data structures of ara::core:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • For dynamic arrays, ara::core::Vector provides analogous insert overloads (for example, for inserting multiple elements [SWS_CORE_01369] or single elements [SWS_CORE_01367]), which are likewise declared as not exception-safe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Associative containers such as ara::core::Map define comparable insertion operations [SWS_CORE_01460] using the same exception behavior.
