                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The synchronous member function replace of class ara::core::BasicString (defined in #include "ara/core/string.h") replaces a subsequence starting at position pos1 with length n1 by a range of string str starting at index pos2 with a maximum length of n2 [SWS_CORE_03107]. The parameter n2 defaults to npos [SWS_CORE_03107]. As a return value, the operation returns a reference to the modified BasicString object [SWS_CORE_03107]. The behavior follows the C++ standard specification [basic.string], with charT being replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03107].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In case of an error, the function deviates from the standard library: If pos > max_size() (Interpretation: presumably the parameter pos1 is meant) or pos2 > str.size() holds, an IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is thrown [SWS_CORE_03107]. The function is explicitly specified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03107].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Since the method is declared as not exception safe, the object potentially remains in an inconsistent state if a violation occurs [SWS_CORE_03107]. Callers must therefore ensure that passed indices lie within the valid boundaries. Special precautions for thread safety are not provided in the specification.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The operation is embedded in the overload set of replace in ara::core::BasicString. It is directly related to variants for complete strings [SWS_CORE_03106], C-strings [SWS_CORE_03108], StringView [SWS_CORE_03312], as well as generic types [SWS_CORE_03313] and iterator ranges [SWS_CORE_03111].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  function replace [SWS_CORE_03108]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  BasicString & replace (size_type pos, size_type n1, const value_type *s, size_type n2);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  As per corresponding usage in [basic.string] except for the following deviations: 1. charT replaced with value_type 2. if ( pos1 > size() ) IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is raised instead of std:: out_of_range 3. IsoStdLengthErrorViolation is raised instead of std::length_error (see condition in [11] )

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function replace of class ara::core::BasicString is provided via header ara/core/string.h [SWS_CORE_03108]. It synchronously replaces a subsequence of the calling string starting at index pos with a maximum length of n1 elements by exactly n2 characters from the passed array pointer s of type const value_type* [SWS_CORE_03108]. The behavior follows the semantics of [basic.string] of ISO/IEC 14882:2017, where AUTOSAR replaces the generic character type charT with value_type [SWS_CORE_03108]. As return value, the function returns a reference to the modified instance (BasicString&) [SWS_CORE_03108].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Violations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  AUTOSAR-specific violations are thrown upon faulty call parameters or capacity exceedances [SWS_CORE_03108]:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation: Is thrown if the start index pos lies past the current string end (declared as pos1 > size() in the specification text; Interpretation: pos1 refers to the parameter pos) [SWS_CORE_03108].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • IsoStdLengthErrorViolation: Is thrown instead of std::length_error if the resulting string length exceeds the limit values [SWS_CORE_03108].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The function is explicitly specified as not exception safe (“not exception safe”) [SWS_CORE_03108]. Because it directly modifies the object, concurrent access by multiple threads to the same instance without external synchronization would likely lead to data races.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The method belongs to a family of related replace overloads of ara::core::BasicString. It complements calls with complete strings ([SWS_CORE_03106], [SWS_CORE_03107]), null-terminated character sequences ([SWS_CORE_03109]), or StringView ([SWS_CORE_03312]) as well as iterator-based replacements as in [SWS_CORE_03112].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The synchronous member function replace of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03109]) replaces at most n1 characters starting from the zero-based index pos with the passed null-terminated character sequence s. The interface is provided via header #include "ara/core/string.h". According to the specification, the behavior follows the C++ standard definition [basic.string] with the documented deviation that charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03109]). As return value, the function delivers a reference to the modified BasicString object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      With regard to exception and error handling, the method is explicitly specified as not exception safe (“not exception safe”) ([SWS_CORE_03109]). Interpretation: If memory allocation fails during execution due to an enlargement of the string, the object presumably remains in an invalid state. While other overloads such as [SWS_CORE_03107] or [SWS_CORE_03108] list specific runtime violations such as IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation or IsoStdLengthErrorViolation, this specification item specifies no separate violations.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Since replace mutates the object state, the call is not concurrency-safe against simultaneous accesses to the same instance. In conjunction with the interface of BasicString, this signature covers null-terminated pointers and complements the other overloads:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • string pointers with explicit length restriction n2 ([SWS_CORE_03108]) or via iterator ranges ([SWS_CORE_03112], [SWS_CORE_03406]),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • replacements via complete or partitioned BasicString instances ([SWS_CORE_03106], [SWS_CORE_03107], [SWS_CORE_03111]),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          function replace [SWS_CORE_03110]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          BasicString & replace (size_type pos, size_type n1, size_type n2, value_type c);

                                                                                                                        As per corresponding usage in [basic.string] except for the following                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           The member function replace of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03110]) serves to synchronously replace a subrange within a string. Starting from the character-based start position pos, it replaces up to n1 existing characters with n2 consecutive copies of the character c of type value_type. As a result, the method returns a reference to the calling BasicString object, which enables chaining of further string operations. The definition is provided via the header file #include "ara/core/string.h" ([SWS_CORE_03110]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          With regard to error and exception behavior, the function is specified as not exception safe (not exception safe) ([SWS_CORE_03110]). The functional behavior is based on the C++ Standard Library definition in [basic.string], with charT being substituted by value_type. Unlike related overloads such as [SWS_CORE_03107] or [SWS_CORE_03108], this signature does not specify explicit violations such as IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation. Interpretation: The lack of exception safety is likely to indicate that no strong guarantees for the object state are maintained in the event of memory allocation errors or invalid range boundaries.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          In interaction with other methods of ara::core::BasicString, the signature forms the index-based counterpart to [SWS_CORE_03414], which performs the same replacement operation using iterators. For replacements of entire strings or views, alternative overloads such as [SWS_CORE_03106] or [SWS_CORE_03312] are available.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              function replace [SWS_CORE_03111]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              BasicString & replace (const_iterator i1, const_iterator i2, const BasicString &str);

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
The member function replace of class ara::core::BasicString synchronously replaces the subrange bounded by the two iterators i1 and i2 with the content of the passed string str [SWS_CORE_03111]. As return value, the function returns a reference to the modified object (*this), whereby method calls can be directly chained [SWS_CORE_03111]. Usage requires including the header file #include "ara/core/string.h" [SWS_CORE_03111].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Restrictions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
The function is explicitly classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03111]. If, for example, an internal memory allocation required to accommodate str fails, the object is not guaranteed to remain in a consistent state. In contrast to index-based overloads such as [SWS_CORE_03107] or [SWS_CORE_03108], which list explicit error checks and violations such as IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation or IsoStdLengthErrorViolation, this iterator-based variant defines no separate violations [SWS_CORE_03111]. Callers must therefore ensure that [i1, i2) represents a valid range within the object (interpretation: passing invalid iterators is likely to lead to undefined behavior).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
Regarding its semantics, the specification refers to the standard C++ behavior under [basic.string] [SWS_CORE_03111]. In ara::core::BasicString, this signature complements index-based replacement with complete strings [SWS_CORE_03106] as well as alternative iterator-based overloads, such as for pointers to character arrays [SWS_CORE_03112], [SWS_CORE_03406], StringView [SWS_CORE_03314] or iterator pairs [SWS_CORE_03411].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  function replace [SWS_CORE_03112]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  BasicString & replace (const_iterator i1, const_iterator i2, const value_type *s, size_type n);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  As per corresponding usage in [basic.string] except for the following deviations: 1. charT replaced with value_type

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function replace of ara::core::BasicString replaces the substring defined by the iterators [i1, i2) with the first n characters of the passed character array s [SWS_CORE_03112]. The call is synchronous and returns a reference to the modified BasicString object [SWS_CORE_03112]. The declaration is provided via the header file ara/core/string.h.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The semantics follow the requirements of the C++ standard for [basic.string], where the type charT is replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03112]. Regarding fault tolerance and exception safety, the operation is explicitly classified as not exception safe (not exception safe) [SWS_CORE_03112]. In contrast to position-based overloads such as [SWS_CORE_03108], no specific violations such as IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation are defined for this iterator variant.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  In interplay within ara::core::BasicString, the function joins a group of related overloads. While this signature inserts an exact number of characters from a pointer, related interfaces allow replacement by full pointer-based strings [SWS_CORE_03406], a StringView [SWS_CORE_03314], or other BasicString instances [SWS_CORE_03111].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function replace [SWS_CORE_03312]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      BasicString & replace (size_type pos1, size_type n1, StringView sv);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      As per corresponding usage in [basic.string]

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The member function replace according to [SWS_CORE_03312] replaces a subrange starting at position pos1 and spanning a length of n1 characters in an instance of ara::core::BasicString with the content of the passed StringView sv. It returns a reference to the modified BasicString object and is oriented toward the C++ standard usage in [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regarding error handling and exception behavior, the function is explicitly specified as not exception safe according to [SWS_CORE_03312]. In contrast to related overloads such as [SWS_CORE_03107], [SWS_CORE_03108], or [SWS_CORE_03313], this signature does not define specific AUTOSAR violations such as IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation, but refers directly to the standard behavior of [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The following constraints and interface relationships apply to the usage:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Declaration is made via the header file #include "ara/core/string.h" in scope ara::core::BasicString [SWS_CORE_03312].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • As a synchronous operation on a mutable string, the function is likely not reentrant on the same instance; concurrent calls presumably require external synchronization.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • 
    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The method complements the iterator-based overload with StringView [SWS_CORE_03314] as well as the index-based overloads for strings [SWS_CORE_03106] and string views from generic types [SWS_CORE_03313].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        •



                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          function replace [SWS_CORE_03313]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          template <class T> BasicString & replace (size_type pos1, size_type n1, const T &t, size_type pos2, size_type n2=npos);
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          As per corresponding usage in [basic.string] except for the following deviations: 1. charT replaced with value_type 2. if ( pos1 > size() || pos2 > sv.size() ) IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is raised instead of std::out_of_range
