                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Member function rfind of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03316]) searches a string backward for the last occurrence of the subsequence described by a StringView sv before or at search position pos (default value npos). It is included via header ara/core/string.h and returns the index of the match as size_type. The semantics follow [basic.string], with charT replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03316]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The operation is declared as noexcept and classified as exception safe ([SWS_CORE_03316]). Specific error codes or error messages (DET/DEM) are not defined in the specification. If the search pattern is not found, the function returns the value npos in accordance with the underlying [basic.string] semantics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Concurrency and Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              As a const method, rfind does not modify the state of the instance; concurrent read accesses to the same string should therefore be permissible without external synchronization. Within ara::core::BasicString, this function represents a modern alternative: While overloads for const value_type* and value_type ([SWS_CORE_03326], [SWS_CORE_03327], [SWS_CORE_03328]) are marked as not exception safe, the StringView variant shares the noexcept guarantee with the overload for const BasicString& ([SWS_CORE_03325]). For read-only string views, a corresponding rfind also exists in ara::core::StringView ([SWS_CORE_02161]).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function rfind of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03325]) searches a string backwards for the last occurrence of the passed substring str. The function is declared in header #include "ara/core/string.h" ([SWS_CORE_03325]). The parameter pos determines the start position of the backward search and is assigned npos by default. The semantics correspond to usage in [basic.string] ([SWS_CORE_03325]). Interpretation: Failure to find the substring is likely signaled by returning npos in accordance with [basic.string].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The method is declared as noexcept and explicitly specified as exception safe (“exception safe”) ([SWS_CORE_03325]). It throws no exceptions at runtime and uses no error codes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Interplay and overloads
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Within class ara::core::BasicString, related overloads exist for search operations:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The overload for StringView ([SWS_CORE_03316]) is likewise exception safe and defined as noexcept.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Overloads for pointers (const value_type*) and individual characters (value_type) are specified as not exception safe (“not exception safe”) according to [SWS_CORE_03326], [SWS_CORE_03327], and [SWS_CORE_03328].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Additionally, class ara::core::StringView provides analogous constexpr search functions ([SWS_CORE_02161], [SWS_CORE_02162], [SWS_CORE_02163], [SWS_CORE_02164]) in which the search begins with pos=0 by default.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      function rfind [SWS_CORE_03326]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      size_type rfind (const value_type *s, size_type pos, size_type n) const;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The member function rfind from [SWS_CORE_03326] serves the synchronous, backward search of a substring within an instance of ara::core::BasicString (defined in #include "ara/core/string.h"). It searches the string backward from the start position pos for the sequence determined by the pointer s and the length specification n. The behavior corresponds to the specification of [basic.string] of the C++ standard, with the difference that charT is replaced by value_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regarding parameter passing and the call context, the implementation is likely to require that s points to an array with at least n valid elements of type value_type, since the base specification does not provide for explicit pointer checks. As a return value, the function provides the found position of type size_type or, in case of failure, the value npos according to standard behavior.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Regarding robustness and concurrency, [SWS_CORE_03326] is specified as not exception safe and has no noexcept specifier. It thus differs fundamentally from the corresponding pointer overload in ara::core::StringView ([SWS_CORE_02163]), which is declared as constexpr and noexcept. Furthermore, it deviates from the BasicString variants for StringView ([SWS_CORE_03316]) and BasicString references ([SWS_CORE_03325]), which are marked as exception safe. It shares the lack of exception safety with overloads [SWS_CORE_03327] and [SWS_CORE_03328].

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          function rfind [SWS_CORE_03327]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          size_type rfind (const value_type *s, size_type pos=npos) const;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The member function rfind of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03327], header file ara/core/string.h) searches backward for the last occurrence of the passed null-terminated string s of type const value_type* starting from start position pos, which defaults to npos. The behavior follows the definition in [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type [SWS_CORE_03327].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The following points apply to usage and boundary conditions:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Call context and parameters: The synchronous search function expects a pointer s to the character sequence to be searched for and optionally the index pos. As size_type, it returns the index position of the beginning of the found substring, or npos if no match is found [SWS_CORE_03327].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Exception safety: In contrast to the overloads for StringView ([SWS_CORE_03316]) and BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03325]), which are declared as noexcept, this function is classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03327]. Presumably, this means that exceptions are not ruled out during execution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Interplay and alternatives: For searches with an additional length limit, the overload with parameter n is available ([SWS_CORE_03326]), while single-character searches are covered via [SWS_CORE_03328]. Provided there is an assignment to ara::core::StringView, corresponding variants declared as exception safe also exist ([SWS_CORE_02161], [SWS_CORE_02164]), which deviatingly use pos = 0 as default value.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            •

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              function rfind [SWS_CORE_03328]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              size_type rfind (value_type c, size_type pos=npos) const;

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The member function rfind of class ara::core::BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03328]) from header ara/core/string.h searches the string backward for the first occurrence of character c of type value_type. The search starts synchronously from position pos, which defaults to npos. The behavior corresponds to the definition in [basic.string], where charT is replaced by value_type ([SWS_CORE_03328]). As a return value, the function returns the index of the found character as size_type.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Error Handling and Concurrency
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              In contrast to the string-based overloads with StringView ([SWS_CORE_03316]) or BasicString ([SWS_CORE_03325]), which are specified as noexcept and exception safe, this single-character search is explicitly classified as not exception safe (not exception safe) according to the specification ([SWS_CORE_03328]). Specific AUTOSAR error codes or notifications to DET or DEM are not provided for this method call. Because this is a const accessor method, purely reading invocation from multiple threads concurrently should be possible as long as the instance is not modified at the same time.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The method complements the pointer overloads of BasicString::rfind ([SWS_CORE_03326] and [SWS_CORE_03327]), which are also classified as not exception safe. If a non-owning string reference is available, ara::core::StringView provides analogous search functions for single characters ([SWS_CORE_02162]) as well as substrings ([SWS_CORE_02161], [SWS_CORE_02163], [SWS_CORE_02164]) that are consistently declared as constexpr and noexcept.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The member function shrink_to_fit() (declared in the specification element as shrink_) belongs to module core and is available in the scope of class ara::core::BasicString via header file #include "ara/core/string.h" [SWS_CORE_03056]. The method has parameterless signature void shrink_to_fit (); and does not return a value [SWS_CORE_03056]. According to requirement, its semantics follow the corresponding usage in [basic.string] [SWS_CORE_03056]. Execution is synchronous and, according to interpretation, serves to adjust the memory capacity to the actual length of the string.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Error Handling and Exception Safety
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  For error handling, it is specified that the method is classified as not exception safe [SWS_CORE_03056]. Special error codes or notifications via DET or DEM do not exist for this operation. If an internal reallocation of memory fails, this error state is expected to propagate directly and without exception protection to the environment.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  

  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Concurrency and Limitations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Because the function shrink_to_fit() modifies internal data structures, a concurrent call on the same instance of ara::core::BasicString is presumably not thread-safe [SWS_CORE_03056]. Calling software components must therefore protect concurrent accesses to the same string externally if needed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          function substr [SWS_CORE_03345]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          BasicString substr (size_type pos=0, size_type n=npos) const;
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          As per corresponding usage in [basic.string] except for the following deviations: 1. if ( pos > size() ) IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is raised instead of std:: out_of_range

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          use
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Method substr of class ara::core::BasicString synchronously creates a new substring of type BasicString according to [SWS_CORE_03345]. The function is available via header file #include "ara/core/string.h". Parameter pos specifies the starting position (default value 0), while n defines the maximum number of characters to take over (default value npos). The semantics largely correspond to the behavior of [basic.string] of the C++ standard.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Error Handling and Restrictions
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          In case of an error, the implementation deliberately deviates from the standard: If pos > size() holds, an IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation is raised instead of a conventional std::out_of_range [SWS_CORE_03345]. Regarding exception safety, the method is classified as not exception safe, which is why callers must pay attention to the state in case of violations or memory allocations for the new BasicString object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          


                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Interaction
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Method substr of class ara::core::StringView exhibits analogous behavior [SWS_CORE_02141]. Both interfaces raise the same IsoStdOutOfRangeViolation on range exceedances (pos > size()). In contrast to the allocating BasicString variant, however, the operation on StringView is specified as constexpr, noexcept, and exception safe.
